description: This file defines a utility function for restoring and fast-forwarding a DataPipe in PyTorch's data pipeline, including handling snapshot states and applying random seeds.

classes.name: _SnapshotState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the snapshot state of a DataPipe, such as Restored.

methods.name: _simple_graph_snapshot_restoration
methods.description: Restores a DataPipe to a previous snapshot state by fast-forwarding it a specified number of iterations, handling snapshot states, and applying a random seed for shuffling.
